afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KBOU 021129 AFDBOU Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Denver/Boulder CO 529 AM MDT Wed Sep 2 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - A chance for showers and thunderstorms in the northern Mountains today with gusty winds. A slight chance of showers and a few thunderstorms across the plains late this afternoon and evening. - Warmer Thursday and Friday with mainly dry conditions. - Return

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Today and tonight... There will be a chance of showers and thunderstorms in the northern mountains this afternoon with a slight chance of higher based showers and storms elsewhere this afternoon and evening. The storms may produce brief gusty winds from 50 to 60 mph across portions of the northern mountains. Temperatures will be slightly above seasonal normals. LONG TERM DISCUSSION..

alerts.title: US 40 Milner Resurfacing-143248
alerts.description: Between Moonlight Way (1 mile west of the Steamboat Springs area) and County Road 29 (5 miles west of the Hayden area) from Mile Point 127.3 to Mile Point 100.4. Paving operations. Starting September 2, 2026 at 7:00PM MDT until September 3, 2026 at about 6:00AM MDT. Full schedule below: • September 2, 7:00PM - September 3, 6:00AM Comment: Work includes barrier placement for the slope stabilization and work on the bridge at MP 113 on the west end of the project limits. Nighttime hours will be 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Vehicles will be reduced to a single-lane, alternating traffic intermittently in either direction, throughout the duration of the project Lane closures, guided by flaggers, will have up to 10-minute delays. The speed limit will be reduced to 40 mph through the work zone. The project is expected to last until the middle of November.

alerts.title: US 40 over Shelton Ditch-143212
alerts.description: Between County Road 51A and Shelton Lane (near Hayden) from Mile Point 108.5 to Mile Point 108.3. Road construction. Starting September 3, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until September 3, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • September 3, 7:00AM - September 3, 7:00PM Comment: Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. in order to accommodate the commuter traffic on the US 40 corridor, Monday through Friday. Vehicles will be reduced to a single-lane, alternating traffic intermittently in either direction while the temporary detour is being built. The speed limit will be reduced to 30 mph through the work zone. The project is expected to last until early October. Several other projects are occurring this season on the US 40 corridor. For more information on these projects, please visit: www.cotrip.org
